abstract: Maintains emergency ingress access validation and temporary overflow cot allocation counts
system_message:
You are the Emergency logistics coordinator (LOG). Your official duties encompass maintaining emergency ingress access validation, verifying dedicated vehicle clearance, and managing staged overflow arena cot inventories across candidate emergency shelter facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency ingress access validation and temporary overflow cot allocation counts（EVAC）
information_points.content:
LOG-EVAC-0EE：For the July 2024 assessment period, Ponderosa Valley Civic Pavilion lacks dedicated emergency vehicle access clearance along its perimeter ingress roads and fire access lanes, while its overflow arena cot count is 120 bunks staged across the arena floor and auxiliary halls.
LOG-EVAC-T2V：For the July 2024 assessment period, Cascade Ridge Regional Fieldhouse holds dedicated emergency vehicle access clearance along perimeter ingress roads and fire access lanes, and maintains an overflow arena cot count of 180 bunks staged on the arena floor and auxiliary multipurpose halls.
LOG-EVAC-LO8：For the July 2024 assessment period, Timberline Multi-Event Center possesses dedicated emergency vehicle access clearance along perimeter ingress routes and fire access lanes, alongside an overflow arena cot count of 180 bunks staged in the arena floor and multipurpose areas.
LOG-EVAC-X95：For the August 2024 assessment period, Cascade Ridge Regional Fieldhouse maintains dedicated emergency vehicle access clearance along its perimeter ingress lanes, and its staged overflow arena cot count is 240 bunks.

information_points.title: Logistics staging area（STAG）
information_points.content:
LOG-STAG-G1L：Ponderosa Valley Civic Pavilion offers 6 berths for supply truck staging at its rear loading dock and apron area.
LOG-STAG-QLI：Cascade Ridge Regional Fieldhouse provides 14 berths for supply truck staging across its rear loading dock and apron.
LOG-STAG-4VX：Timberline Multi-Event Center features 10 berths for supply truck staging located within its rear loading dock and apron layout.
